title: A local degree-zero structure-unit test for a perfect complex
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $K$ a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] in $D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $a:\mathcal O_S[0]\to K$ a morphism and $s\in S$. Derived pullback is as in [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Suppose $H^i(Li_s^*K)=0$ for every $i<0$, where $i_s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ is the residue-field morphism [def-pc-base-change], and $H^0(Li_s^*a)$ is an isomorphism. Then the map $H^0(a)_s$ on module stalks [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] is surjective. There is no condition on the fibres at other points.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-perfect-finite-free-residue-model] at $s$. The negative terms are zero and the degree-zero term has rank one. The fibre map identifies degree-zero fibre cohomology with the residue field. Over that field all differentials vanish: the cohomology dimensions equal the term dimensions, so both adjacent differential ranks vanish.

Restrict $a$ to the affine neighbourhood and use [lem-pc-perfect-affine-map-representative] with the single rank-one structure-sheaf complex as source and the bounded finite free representative as target. Take stalks at $s$. Its degree-zero component is multiplication by an element with nonzero residue, hence by a unit. The chain-map equation makes the outgoing differential zero. No incoming term remains. Degree-zero cohomology is therefore the rank-one term, and multiplication by the inverse unit supplies every preimage. Exactness of stalks transports this computation to $H^0(a)_s$.

      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]

      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hK : Scheme.IsPerfect S K)
    (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ K) (s : S)
    (hnegative : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) i).obj
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).obj K)))
    (ha : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map a))) :
    Function.Surjective (Scheme.Modules.Hom.stalkLinearMap
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map a) s)
